module_summary: Lemmings Moore FSM: a 3-bit state register with combinational next-state logic over ground/dig/bump inputs, outputs decoded from state.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: Six-state walk/fall/dig controller register; all outputs are decoded from it.

anchors.name: walk_left
anchors.why: Decoded output asserted in walk-left state.

anchors.name: walk_right
anchors.why: Decoded output asserted in walk-right state.

anchors.name: aaah
anchors.why: Decoded output asserted in either falling state.

anchors.name: digging
anchors.why: Decoded output asserted in either digging state.

anchors.name: dig
anchors.why: Dig command input moving a walking lemming into digging states.

groups.name: Lemming controller
groups.description: State register and next-state logic reacting to ground, dig and bump inputs.

groups.name: Output decode
groups.description: Moore outputs decoded from the state register.
